previous.title: Aurelius/Lytix oncolytic peptide plus adoptive T-cell immunotherapy for canine B-cell lymphoma
previous.status: Actively recruiting — confirmed on Aurelius current pilot-study page
previous.funding: Fully funded; Aurelius states there is no additional expense to owners for the trial.
previous.notes: Initial pilot study combining an oncolytic peptide with adoptive T-cell immunotherapy for previously untreated stage 3–5(a) canine B-cell lymphoma. Almost all study treatment is performed in Bellingham, Washington; initial treatment requires about three days, followed by at least two later visits approximately a month afterward.
